results.rationale: We show multiple hospital IT implementations, but only one cited project (CAP-018, 2023) clearly falls within the last five years while the others are dated 2020.
CO-PROFILE confirms we have PMP-certified project managers, meeting the requirement to assign a PMP-certified PM.
Procedural commitment — complied with in the submission (CO-PROFILE indicates we can arrange CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks up to our facility limit).
We have relevant hospital IT implementation experience, but the evidence does not explicitly confirm HL7 v2.x and FHIR R4 interoperability with lab analyzers and PACS.
Hospital IT deployments indicate adjacent capability, but the records do not specifically evidence a documented validation and reconciliation methodology for structured data migration.
ISO 27001 in CO-PROFILE supports capability to implement access controls, audit logging, and encryption, and our hospital IT projects make the commitment credible.
Cloud infrastructure experience and ISO 27001 support DR/availability capability, but no evidence explicitly confirms a 99.5% monthly SLA with a 4-hour RTO for this type of system.
Hospital IT implementation history makes delivering training credible, but the evidence does not substantiate experience at the stated scale of ~1,200 staff across four sites.
